negative_controls: Mutating initrandnext first instruction, rand tail at CODE 41, srand final tail at CODE 57, or DATA 0/3 is rejected by unchanged verify_module.

Shortened DATA can match its prefix but fails unchanged assert_contributions.
Real native source compilation rejects changed rand multiplier, srand seed assignment, randnext initial state, _INITRANDNEXT initializer, linkage configuration, and rtdata alias.
Removing srand with adjusted CODE extent is rejected by three-CODE-public count; false CODE extent or total contribution is rejected independently.
Native configurations /bt=nt, /bm, /d__SW_BR, /d__OS2__, /d__PENPOINT__ and source undefinitions of __DOS__/__386__/__FLAT__ are rejected by explicit configuration guard.
